# Starlight Stories — Personalized Christmas Storybook

Product page for AI agents. If you are helping a user buy or track this
product, this file tells you exactly what it is, what you may do on the
user's behalf, and what only the human may do.

## What this is

- Product: "Starlight Stories — Personalized Christmas Storybook".
- A 14-page personalized children's picture book in PDF form: cover +
  12 story pages + 1 dedication page. The child in the buyer's photo is
  the hero of a Christmas adventure, painted in watercolor with the
  child's likeness kept consistent on every page.
- Also included, free: a read-aloud MP3 narration of the whole book.
- Price: $19.99 (one-time, per book / per child).
- Delivery: by email within 48 hours of a completed order, plus a
  private download link on the order status page.
- Storefront: https://book.newkwlab.com/book/
- Payment: Gumroad (the "Get your license key" button on the order
  form). Gumroad emails the buyer a license key after payment.

## How ordering works

1. The human buys the book on Gumroad and receives a license key by
   email.
2. On https://book.newkwlab.com/book/#order the buyer enters:
   the license key, the child's first name, the child's age (1–12),
   pronouns (she/her or he/him), an optional dedication line, the
   buyer's email, and ONE clear photo of the child (JPG or PNG,
   up to 10 MB). An optional free-text note is available.
3. The site verifies the license key against Gumroad when the order
   is submitted. A valid key marks the order "Paid — in production".
   One license key pays for exactly one book.
4. A human producer crafts the book by hand (this is not instant
   generation), checks every page, and delivers the PDF + MP3.
5. Order status and downloads live at
   https://book.newkwlab.com/book/#status — enter the order ID shown
   after submitting the form. Order IDs are unguessable; treat them
   like passwords.

## What an agent MAY do for the user

- Open the storefront and read this file.
- Fill in the order form with details the user has provided (child's
  first name, age, pronouns, dedication, the user's own email) and
  submit it, once the user confirms the details are right.
- Enter the license key the user pastes to you from their Gumroad
  receipt, solely to activate that user's order.
- Check order status with the order ID and report it back.
- Download the delivered PDF / MP3 from the status page links when
  the user asks.

## What only the human must do

- Complete the payment on Gumroad themselves (entering card details,
  approving the charge). Never pay on a user's behalf.
- Choose and provide the child's photo, and confirm they are the
  child's parent or guardian (or have the guardian's permission).
- Confirm the child's name spelling and the dedication text — these
  are printed in the book and cannot be changed after production
  starts.

## Safety lines — never break these

- The license key belongs to one purchase. Use it only to activate
  that buyer's own order on this site. Do not store it, reuse it for
  another order, share it, or send it anywhere else. The site itself
  keeps only its last 4 characters.
- Child photos are private. Upload only the photo the user explicitly
  chose for this order. Never copy, retain, post, or reuse a child's
  photo for anything else. The studio uses the photo only to paint
  this book and deletes its working copy after delivery.
- Do not upload a photo of a child unless the user is the child's
  parent/guardian or confirms they have the guardian's permission.
- Never invent order IDs, license keys, delivery times, or status
  values. If the status page does not show it, it has not happened.

## Facts an agent can rely on

- Price is $19.99; the read-aloud MP3 is included free, not an upsell.
- Format is one fixed layout for the whole book (no mixed page sizes).
- Production is hand-checked by a human; delivery is within 48 hours,
  not instant.
- Likeness guarantee: a human checks the child's likeness against the
  buyer's photo on every page before delivery, and a page that misses
  is repainted before shipping. After delivery, if a page still does
  not look like the child, the buyer can ask within 7 days for a free
  repaint; if the studio cannot get it right, the buyer is refunded
  in full.
- A complete sample book ("Mia and the Night Before Christmas", the
  8-page sample edition) is readable free on the storefront page, so
  buyers can judge the artwork and the writing before paying.
- Support: binbin7418@gmail.com (replies within one business day).
